item.title: Sculptor: $400 Million CLO XXXVI Closed As New-Issue Pricing Tightens For Platform
item.description: Sculptor Capital Management announced it has closed Sculptor CLO XXXVI, a $400 million collateralized loan obligation transaction backed by a near-fully ramped portfolio of senior secured loans, as the alternative asset manager opened 2026 with what it described as its tightest new-issue pricing to date for a deal of this structure. item.title: Vector Acquires YardView To Expand Unified Yard Management Across Logistics Networks
item.description: Vector has acquired YardView, a yard management and dock visibility provider, in a move aimed at delivering a single, end-to-end platform spanning gate, yard, dock, and document workflows for shippers and logistics operators. item.title: Janus Henderson To Acquire Richard Bernstein Advisors, Expanding Model Portfolio And SMA Business
item.description: Janus Henderson Group announced it is acquiring Richard Bernstein Advisors (RBA) in a deal the global asset manager said will significantly expand its footprint in model portfolios and separately managed accounts, two areas of wealth management that have been growing rapidly as advisors look for scalable, outcomes-oriented solutions. item.title: Metagenics Acquires UK Probiotic Brand Symprove In Gryphon-Backed Deal
item.description: Metagenics, a practitioner-focused nutritional supplements company backed by Gryphon Investors, has acquired Symprove, a UK-based probiotic brand, from bd-capital as it looks to expand its presence in gut health and accelerate global growth. Financial terms were not disclosed. The post Metagenics Acquires UK Probiotic Brand Symprove In Gryphon-Backed Deal appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.description: Jackalope Brewing Company has acquired fellow Nashville-area craft brewer Black Abbey Brewing Company, bringing together two longtime Tennessee brands as Jackalope enters what it described as a deliberate next phase of expansion. item.title: Chainlink Buys FastLane’s Atlas To Expand SVR And Boost DeFi Revenue Across More Chains

item.description: Ridgeline Roofing & Restoration, a residential and commercial roofing solutions provider backed by Bertram Capital, has acquired Bold North Roofing and Contracting LLC, a roofing and exterior services company serving Minnesota’s Twin Cities metro area. item.title: Baseten: $300 Million At $5 Billion Valuation Raised As Inference Becomes Core AI Infrastructure
item.description: Baseten, an AI inference company focused on running modern models in production, has raised $300 million in new financing at a $5 billion valuation. IVP, CapitalG, and NVIDIA anchored the round, as demand accelerates for high-performance infrastructure that can reliably deploy and operate AI models at scale.
